### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://www.hulu.com/watch/a7976d43-3985-4dc2-9099-ec1767d6a031](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hulu.com%2Fwatch%2Fa7976d43-3985-4dc2-9099-ec1767d6a031) ### Comment > It used to be that using Adguard on Hulu let you fast forward through commercials and the captions and pic would get out of sync, and you'd have to click "watch credits" in order to see the end of the episode because things would be, by the end of a show, 4-5 minutes out of sync. Now with Adguard running you can still ffwd through commercials, but the "out of sync" problem makes it so the episode will end early, sometimes just cutting off a few minutes sometimes cutting off over 5 minutes (whatever is after the last commercial). It's inconsistent how much time is lost but with AdGuard running there's no way to see the last few minutes of the episode, you have to turn it off, let it reload, watch a few commercials, in order to see the last few minutes of each episode.
